license_policy: CC0 or CC-BY only for dataset sources, including reused sources; existing user-authorized recordings retained
validation_policy: one unaugmented energy-center window per source file; also report original-recording and uploader macro recall
training_policy: uniform original-recording sampling within each class; augmentation uses train backgrounds only
split_policy: Preserve all 1474 upstream sources, source identities, hashes, and purposes exactly
holdout_access: metadata identities/hashes only; never D5 audio or features
live_replay: No old or new video, live replay, D5 audio or D5 features consumed
speech_mapping: All upstream ordinary_speech subtype sources become speech; retain original weak labels and report explicit-speech subset separately
noise_bank: Train background only, excluding ordinary_speech and crying_screaming; never any human voice as noise
